One row per endpoint. This is also the **wiring tracker**: is the API built, and is each app actually using it?
Columns BE / Web / Mob: ⬜ not started · 🟨 in progress · 🧩 built but not connected (API unused, or screen not wired to the API) · ✅ built + connected + tested · — no consumer planned.
Add the row when you **plan** an endpoint (BE ⬜), and update it the moment any side changes. Then run `pnpm status`.
